message.content:
**Your 7‑Day Paris Adventure – A Complete Travel Plan** | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **1** | Arrive in Paris (Charles de Gaulle or Orly). Take the RER B or a taxi to your hotel in the 7th arrondissement (near Eiffel Tower). | Check‑in, freshen up. Walk along the Seine, visit the Musée d’Orsay (open 9 am–5:45 pm). | Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (classic French cuisine). Night stroll to the Eiffel Tower lights. | | **2** | Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près). Visit Notre‑Cathédrale and Sainte‑Chapelle. | Lunch at **L’As du Fallafel** (Marais). Explore Le Marais: Picasso Museum, boutique shops. | Dinner at **Septime** (Michelin‑starred, reservations needed). | | **3** | Early morning visit to the Louvre (open 9 am–6 pm). | Lunch near Palais Royal. Walk through Jardin des Tuileries to Place de la Concorde. | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower restaurant). | | **4** | Day trip to Versailles: Palace, Gardens, Hall of Mirrors. | Picnic lunch in the gardens (pick up baguette, cheese, wine). | Return to Paris. Light dinner at **L’Avant‑Garde** (modern French). | | **5** | Explore Montmartre: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre. | Lunch at **Le Consulat**. Visit the Salvador Dalí Museum. | Dinner at **La Maison Rose**. Optional cabaret at Moulin Rouge. | | **6** | Visit the Pompidou Centre (modern art). | Lunch at **Café du Musée**. Stroll through the Latin Quarter, visit Panthéon. | Dinner at **Le Procope** (oldest café in Paris). | | **7** | Free morning: last‑minute shopping or revisit favorite spots. | Lunch at **L’Arpège** (Michelin‑starred, vegetarian options). | Depart from Paris. | --- ### Practical Details | Item | Recommendation | |------|----------------| | **Flights** | Book a round‑trip flight to Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). Use airlines like Air France, KLM, or budget carriers such as Ryanair/Eurowings. | | **Accommodation** | 4‑star boutique hotel in the 7th or 4th arrondissement. Example: **Hotel Le Six** (7th) or **Hotel Henriette** (4th). | | **Transport** | Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (valid for 2–5 days, unlimited metro/bus/RER). For day trips, buy a **Versailles ticket** or use a guided tour. | | **Dining** | Reserve Michelin‑starred restaurants in advance (Septime, Le Jules Verne, L’Arpège). Try local bistros for casual meals. | | **Budget** | Approx. €1200–€1500 per person (excluding flights):
• Hotel: €200–€300/night
• Meals: €50–€80/day
• Attractions: €30–€60/day
• Transport: €20–€30/day | | **Packing** | Comfortable walking shoes, umbrella, light jacket (Paris weather can be unpredictable), power adapter (Type C/F). | | **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most places accept English. | | **Safety** | Keep valuables secure, beware of pickpockets in tourist areas. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Book tickets online** for major attractions (Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Versailles) to skip queues. 2. **Try local specialties**: croissants, escargot, macarons, and French wine. 3. **Use the Metro**: it’s efficient and covers most sights. 4. **Stay flexible**: allow time for spontaneous discoveries—Paris thrives on serendipity. Enjoy your Parisian escapade! If you’d like a shorter trip, a 3‑day version can be crafted similarly. Bon voyage!
